import ctypes

# Load libraries in correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

def get_gsl_precision_constants():
    # Define array types for the constants (3 double values)
    double_array_3 = ctypes.c_double * 3
    
    # Access the constant arrays
    constants = {
        "gsl_prec_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_eps")),
        "gsl_prec_sqrt_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_sqrt_eps")),
        "gsl_prec_root3_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_root3_eps")),
        "gsl_prec_root4_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_root4_eps")),
        "gsl_prec_root5_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_root5_eps")),
        "gsl_prec_root6_eps": list(double_array_3.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_prec_root6_eps"))
    }
    return constants

def assert_test():
    constants = get_gsl_precision_constants()
    
    # Test that all constants are retrieved
    expected_keys = ["gsl_prec_eps", "gsl_prec_sqrt_eps", "gsl_prec_root3_eps", 
                    "gsl_prec_root4_eps", "gsl_prec_root5_eps", "gsl_prec_root6_eps"]
    assert all(key in constants for key in expected_keys), "Missing some constant arrays"
    
    # Test that each constant has exactly 3 values
    for key, values in constants.items():
        assert len(values) == 3, f"{key} should have 3 values"
        assert all(isinstance(v, float) for v in values), f"{key} values should be floats"
    
    # Test specific known values (GSL_DBL_EPSILON should be ~2.22e-16)
    dbl_epsilon = constants["gsl_prec_eps"][0]
    assert abs(dbl_epsilon - 2.220446049250313e-16) < 1e-20, "GSL_DBL_EPSILON value incorrect"
    
    # Test that sqrt values are actually square roots
    eps = constants["gsl_prec_eps"]
    sqrt_eps = constants["gsl_prec_sqrt_eps"]
    for i in range(3):
        assert abs(sqrt_eps[i] - (eps[i] ** 0.5)) < 1e-20, f"Square root relationship violated at index {i}"
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
